findings: The FAQ compares regional staked DEC with regional demand; its 400000/500000 example gives 80% output.
The public preview applies strongest Dark Discount to raw worker demand, scales by retained/raw base after cap, rounds to three decimals then rounds upward to an integer.
Fully clipped workers have zero demand. Runi removes plot DEC demand and uses efficiency one.
serverPolicy: Replace current_plot_required_dec within current_required_dec with new plot demand; hold every other plot and staked DEC fixed.
Require exactly one supplied-efficiency or regional-snapshot mode.
Require raw worker demand in regional mode unless Runi removes that demand.
Zero regional demand uses efficiency one to avoid an undefined ratio.
limits: Public-rule and client-preview based. Regional inputs and backend agreement are not live-verified; moving workers from other plots also requires updating those plots in the supplied snapshot.
